title: Colombo weekly dengue cases and weather (real, public)
provenance: Public dataset: R package 'colmozzie' (Thiyanga Talagala), https://github.com/thiyangt/colmozzie, commit c964aa4. Compiled from the Weekly Epidemiological Reports of the Epidemiology Unit, Ministry of Health, Sri Lanka.
description: One row per week for Colombo district: notified dengue cases with that week's weather. Lagged case counts and recent rainfall were added by scripts/fetch_public_datasets.py using past weeks only.
context: Genuine Sri Lankan public-health surveillance data (Colombo district).

features.cases_last_week: Notified cases in the previous week (derived)
features.rainfall_prev_4_weeks_mm: Rainfall over the previous four weeks (derived)
features.dengue_cases: Target: notified dengue cases in the week

target_definition: dengue_cases = total notified dengue cases in Colombo district for the week.
known_limitations: Weekly time series: random cross-validation is optimistic compared with a strict forward-in-time evaluation.
The first two weeks have missing lag values (handled by imputation).
anonymisation: Aggregate counts only; no individual patient data.
